personalInfo.name: Koundinya Pidaparthy
personalInfo.summary: Full-stack Software Engineer specializing in JavaScript and TypeScript (React, Next.js, Node.js) with production experience shipping web apps, REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud services. Strong at performance work, incident response, and building AI-assisted products with agents and eval loops. MS in Computer Science (GPA 3.95).

achievements: Graduate Teaching Assistant — Data Structures & Algorithms

points: Architected and shipped core modules of an AI-first operating system layer using Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, and React Server Components, reducing time-to-interactive by 38%.
Designed and implemented a real-time collaboration engine using WebSockets and Redis pub/sub, enabling sub-100ms latency for multi-user document editing across distributed sessions.
Built a plugin/extension marketplace infrastructure supporting dynamic module loading via Module Federation, cutting third-party integration time from weeks to days.
Established CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and AWS CDK, automating deployments to ECS Fargate with zero-downtime blue/green releases.
Led the migration of a monolithic REST API to a GraphQL federation layer (Apollo Router + subgraphs), improving query performance by 45% and eliminating N+1 issues.
Mentored two junior engineers through weekly 1:1s, code review culture, and pair programming sessions, accelerating their onboarding by 30%.
Contributed to the early-stage product by building the core dashboard UI using React, Zustand, and Tailwind CSS, establishing the design-system foundation adopted by the full team.
Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication flow with NextAuth.js supporting Google and GitHub providers, reducing login friction and improving conversion by 22%.
Developed RESTful API endpoints in Node.js/Express integrated with MongoDB Atlas, powering the user preferences and settings modules.
Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest and React Testing Library, achieving 82% code coverage on critical user-flow components.
Collaborated with the design team to translate Figma prototypes into pixel-perfect, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) React components using Framer Motion for micro-interactions.
Built and maintained customer-facing ticketing and event management features using React, Redux, and GraphQL, serving over 2 million annual users across ferry and dining experience platforms.
Optimized SQL and MongoDB query patterns, reducing average API response time from 850ms to 210ms for the high-traffic booking service.
Integrated Stripe payment gateway with idempotent transaction handling, processing $5M+ in monthly bookings with a 99.98% success rate.
Developed a seat-selection microservice in Node.js/TypeScript backed by DynamoDB with DynamoDB Streams for real-time availability updates.
Implemented feature flags with LaunchDarkly enabling gradual rollouts to 5% → 100% of users, reducing production incidents by 60%.
Participated in on-call rotation, triaging and resolving P1/P2 incidents for the ticketing platform with an average MTTR of under 25 minutes.
Developed responsive SaaS dashboard components in React and Material UI for Google Workspace backup and recovery products, improving user task completion rate by 18%.
Built reusable component library with Storybook documentation, standardizing UI patterns across 4 product teams and reducing duplicate code by 35%.
Integrated Google Drive and Gmail APIs to display backup status, quota usage, and restore progress with real-time polling using React Query.
Implemented lazy loading, code splitting, and image optimization strategies, cutting initial bundle size from 1.8MB to 620KB and improving Lighthouse score from 54 to 89.
Collaborated in an Agile/Scrum environment with two-week sprints, participating in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
